blocks.text: a) Identification of carbonate CO₃²⁻ radical

blocks.caption: Identification of carbonate radical
rows: Take about 2 g of solid carbonate sample in a clean test tube and then add about 5 cm³ of dilute HCl solution. Pass the gas evolved in the above step through a solution of lime water.
Effervescence takes place during which a gas evolves briskly, that turns lime water turns milky.

blocks.text: Reactions involved in the above steps

blocks.text_alt: Ca(OH)₂(aq) (lime water) + CO₂(g) → CaCO₃(s) (white ppt) + H₂O(l)
